Agentic Coding Studio.

A learner-directed environment where young people work with AI coding agents to make games, stories, simulations, and applications.

View project funding →All platforms

About the platform

Keep young creators in charge.

Agentic Coding Studio is being designed for informal STEM learning environments. Learners direct an AI coding agent while remaining responsible for defining goals, reviewing plans, testing results, and improving what they create.

The project will work with community learning partners to broaden access to AI and computing education while studying what learners understand when the mechanics of code generation change.

Platform access: Development begins with the 2027–2029 NSF-funded project. A public platform link has not yet been released.

LearnersYouth in informal STEM programs
FocusAgency, computational thinking, and AI literacy
ExperienceDirect, test, and revise work with coding agents

Learning design

More than asking AI for an answer.

Set Intentions

Learners decide what they want to make and break a larger goal into workable parts.

Evaluate Plans

Young creators review what an agent proposes instead of accepting every suggestion.

Test and Revise

Learners check whether an artifact works and improve it through repeated cycles.

In development

Follow the research as the studio takes shape.

The project is supported by the National Science Foundation and will develop learning activities, educator materials, and research findings for broader use.
